text: Set a fixed screen time (for example: 30 minutes only after lunch). At this age, the child does not manage their own time—it is your role to set the limits.

review_defects.field: الطفل في هذا العمر لا يحدد وقته
review_defects.english: does not manage their own time
review_defects.why: The Arabic verb 'يحدد' means 'determine' or 'set', not 'manage'. The child does not set his own screen time; the parent must set it. 'Manage' implies a broader time management skill, altering the meaning.

review_defects.english: it is your role to set the limits
review_defects.why: The Arabic says 'your role is to determine' (the time), without an explicit object. The English adds 'the limits', which is not present and slightly shifts the focus from setting the time to setting boundaries in general.
